_about: Trend tooltip text, v2 (short, plain). Each tooltip shows: the card title (Back/Fade + title), the meaning line, the direction line for Fade cards only, then an auto-generated 'Last time:' line from the most recent game that fit. Nothing else. {blowout_margin} is filled per sport from the sports config (e.g. 3 goals, 15 points).

direction.Fade: Fade means bet the other side.

last_time_format.side: Last time: {date}, {team} was {price} vs {opp}. {winner} won the {segment} {score}.
last_time_format.note: {result} is the plain outcome of the bet, e.g. 'Over 1.5', 'both teams scored', 'tied'. Never a ✓ or ✗.

home_fav.title: Home favorites
home_fav.meaning: The home team is favored to win the {segment}.

road_dog.title: Road underdogs
road_dog.meaning: The road team is the underdog.

home_dog.title: Home underdogs
home_dog.meaning: The home team is the underdog.

b2b.title: Teams on a back-to-back
b2b.meaning: A team that played yesterday, facing a rested opponent.

b2b_opp.title: Opponents of a back-to-back team
b2b_opp.meaning: A rested team facing an opponent that played yesterday.

rested.title: Rested teams
rested.meaning: A team with more days off than its opponent.

tired.title: Tired teams
tired.meaning: A team with fewer days off than its opponent.

off_loss.title: Teams off a loss
off_loss.meaning: A team that lost its last game.

off_loss3.title: Teams off a blowout
off_loss3.meaning: A team that lost its last game by {blowout_margin} or more.

off_shutout.title: Teams off a shutout
off_shutout.meaning: A team that was shut out in its last game.

div.title: Divisional games
div.meaning: Two teams from the same division.

rest_edge.title: Rest edge games
rest_edge.meaning: One team has more days off than the other.

even_rest.title: Even rest games
even_rest.meaning: Both teams have the same days off.

b2b_game.title: Back-to-back games
b2b_game.meaning: At least one team played yesterday.

off_loss_game.title: Team off a loss
off_loss_game.meaning: At least one team lost its last game.

off_loss3_game.title: Team off a blowout
off_loss3_game.meaning: At least one team lost its last game by {blowout_margin} or more.

off_shutout_game.title: Team off a shutout
off_shutout_game.meaning: At least one team was shut out last game.

tug_of_war.label: 🪢 Tug of war
tug_of_war.tooltip: One team usually goes Over, the other usually goes Under.

mismatch.label: 🥊 Mismatch
mismatch.tooltip: One team usually wins the {segment}, the other usually loses it.

matchup_labels.lean_rule: 'Usually' = 60% or more of their games, with at least 10 played. For BTTS, Over reads 'both teams score' and Under reads 'not both teams score'.

record_line.tooltip: Record betting this trend this season, how often it won, how often the same bet won across all games, and profit at 1 unit per bet.

streaks.section: Teams on a run of 3 or more straight in the opening segment, counted from their most recent game. A tie or push ends a streak.
streaks.colors: Win and loss streaks run green to red. Over/Under and Yes/No streaks get darker the longer they run.
